svg.title: E08: On-demand adaptation target selection
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Evolution / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Choose harness versus weight adaptation.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: An embodied agent encounters a task or distribution shift.
An adaptation controller evaluates task performance and cost.
Adaptation target policy, harness and weight candidates, and evaluation
feedback.
The controller selects a declared adaptation target and records why.
Task state, candidate adaptation targets, and cost or risk are observable.
The selected target is compatible with the current execution environment.
Adaptation does not silently combine targets outside the declared policy.
Unsupported target or uncertain evidence falls back to a safe target or no
adaptation.
1 TaskState → AdaptationController observe(trace)
2 AdaptationController → HarnessCandidate propose(harness)
3 AdaptationController → WeightCandidate propose(weights)
4 HarnessCandidate → EvaluationFeedback evaluate()
5 WeightCandidate → EvaluationFeedback evaluate()
6 EvaluationFeedback → SelectedTarget select(target)
7 EvaluationFeedback ↩ AdaptationController rollback(failure)
Harness adaptation, weight adaptation, recursive adaptation, and embodied task
domain.
Test target choice, unsupported change, reversibility, and transfer.
A paper citation or generic fine-tuning script is not an E08 instance.
